title: Gods’ Games We Play
description: In a world of idle gods, humans are forced into brain challenges with them. With three defeats, gods lose their right to challenge, while 10 victories spell human triumph. Fay, determined to achieve the impossible, enters the ultimate test of wits against the gods. Will he defy divinity, or is he just another loss in the making?

episodes_data.title: Gods’ Games We Play Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: After being trapped in a glacier for 3,000 years, Leshea awakens. The former god demands that someone bring her the best person to play games in this age. The one who is chosen is Fay, a young man who is 3 and 0 currently in the gods' games. (HindiAnimeVerse.com)

episodes_data.title: Gods’ Games We Play Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Fay and Leshea are thrown into their first gods' game together against Titan. The game they play is Hide-and-God-Seek. Fay and Leshea try to outsmart Titan as their teammates get incapacitated one after another. Translated By Subsflix.com

episodes_data.title: Gods’ Games We Play Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Fay and Leshea are told that they need to find some other team members to participate in the gods' games with them. They happen to meet another Apostle named Pearl Diamond, but she seems to have an interesting past with a different team...

episodes_data.title: Gods’ Games We Play Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Fay, Leshea, and Pearl join up with Pearl's former team to try to take down the god Uroboros in the gods' games.

episodes_data.title: Gods’ Games We Play Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Fay, Leshea, and Pearl are invited to the city of Mal-ra to participate in something called the World Games Tour.
